# slack_usergroup (Data Source)

Looks up a Slack user group by ID, name or handle. Exactly one of id, name or handle must be set. Disabled user groups are found too; check enabled.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `handle` (String) Handle of the user group, the part after the @ used to mention it. Conflicts with id and name.
- `id` (String) ID of the user group, for example S0123456789. Conflicts with name and handle.
- `name` (String) Name of the user group. Conflicts with id and handle.

### Read-Only

- `auto_type` (String) Kind of automatic user group, such as admin or owner. Empty for a custom user group.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the user who created the user group.
- `deleted_by` (String) ID of the user who disabled the user group. Empty while it is enabled.
- `description` (String) Description of the user group.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user group is enabled. A disabled group has a deletion date.
- `is_external` (Boolean) Whether the user group is shared from another workspace.
- `is_user_group` (Boolean) Whether the object is a user group.
- `prefs` (Attributes) Default channels and groups the members of the user group are added to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefs))
- `team_id` (String) ID of the workspace the user group belongs to.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the user who last updated the user group.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users in the user group.
- `users` (List of String) IDs of the users in the user group.

<a id="nestedatt--prefs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefs`

Read-Only:

- `channels` (List of String) IDs of the channels every member of the user group joins.
- `groups` (List of String) IDs of the private channels every member of the user group joins.
